verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage ships its own built-in AI agents: a Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent and a Transaction Monitoring agent. Teams delegate work by assigning cases to an agent, which auto-remediates level 1 alerts, escalates high-risk cases to humans, and can have its decisions reviewed or overridden. Delegation is limited to alert and case remediation, the Starter configuration cannot be customized, and the evidence is marketing-page snippets only. missing for 10: general-purpose task delegation beyond alert/case remediation, conversational assistant interface, in-depth first-party docs on agent behavior and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
